description: Frozen deterministic Stage 5 capability/regression suite. This suite verifies the gateway path; it is not a model-quality benchmark.

cases.prompt: List the three colored shapes visible in the image. Use one '<color> <shape>' phrase for each object.
Read the course code, room, and due time from the image. Return them in the form course|room|time.
Read the row in the table. Return course|task|due_time using the text shown in the image.
Describe the spatial relationship between the two colored objects using '<object A> <relation> <object B>'.
Read the large number in the first image and the large number in the second image, then add them. Return first=<n>; second=<n>; sum=<n>.
Read the status and error code from the dialog. Return status|error_code exactly from what is visible.
